single_variable: Same-process original model thread vs prepared real model subprocess; original consumer/GUI-free fixed work unchanged.
budget: Exactly4 fresh-process pairs, local/process, process/local, process/local, local/process. Delivery windows are excluded from performance cohort, not replaced.
accounting: Parent-only process counters never compared as whole-systemCPU; child separately recorded. Parent modelThreadCPU is proxyCPU in isolated arm. No GIL share or CPUfrequency inference.
failure_policy: Stop on semantic/runtime failure; retain every window and locks. No added windows or threshold relaxation.
decision: Passing fixed-work effect only selects a candidate for actualGUI1000Hz pending/contact-to-paint test; it cannot prove that visual isolation fixes original symptom.
